include.description:
When specified on member methods of Persistable type dispatcher will ensure that all fields from this include spec
are present in the `this` instance. This avoids need for the member method implementation to hit the database.

Can also be specified on the before/after callback functions on Persistable types.  This will indicate that
those fields are the only required fields for calling those callbacks.  This can improve performance as the
default is to include the entire obj, as fetched from the db, with the input updates applied to it.  This allows
that fetch to be minimized.

When specified on persistable type, it applies to all of the type's member functions and fields (useful when used
in other types method as function params)
